name: @w6w-apps/brandfetch
description: Look up a brand's logos, colors, fonts and company data by domain, ticker, ISIN, crypto symbol or card transaction with Brandfetch.

w6w.longDescription:
Brandfetch turns a company identifier into its brand: logos and icons in SVG, PNG and WebP, the color palette, fonts, imagery, social links, description and company facts (industry, employees, founding year, headquarters, ticker and ISIN).

A workflow can look a brand up by domain, website URL, email address, brand id, stock or ETF ticker, ISIN or crypto symbol, search brands by name, read a brand's narrative context (positioning, voice and visual style) as JSON or Markdown, and resolve a raw card-transaction label to the merchant behind it. Account usage against the plan's credit allowance is readable for free.

The connection holds a Brandfetch API key, sent as a bearer token. An optional Brand Search client ID can be added; it is sent only on name searches. The Logo CDN (cdn.brandfetch.io) is not an action: it serves images straight from a URL and needs no call.
